evidence.note: O1-Pruner identifies 'length disharmony' -- shorter responses often achieve equal or higher accuracy than longer ones, at both the instance and distribution level -- and fine-tunes long-thought models with a PPO-style Length-Harmonizing Reward that rewards brevity relative to a reference model's own pre-sampled length/accuracy baseline, subject to an accuracy non-degradation constraint, cutting solution length by 34.7-40.5% while improving accuracy.
evidence.title: O1-Pruner: Length-Harmonizing Fine-Tuning for O1-Like Reasoning Pruning
